name: audit2 unhandledRejection handler with a Promise parameter
source: function main(): void { process.on("unhandledRejection", (r: unknown, p: Promise<unknown>) => { console.log("UR", r instanceof Error ? r.message : r, p instanceof Promise); }); Promise.reject(new Error("one")); Promise.reject("two"); const p = Promise.reject(new Error("handled later")); setTimeout(() => p.catch(() => console.log("late catch")), 5); }
